title: [Renseikai] Event Attendance - Setting ON (Student + Parent) - Student submits response as Attend
description: Verify that when the event allows both student and parent responses, a student can submit attendance response in advance from Learner App with status Attend.
preconditions:
Event E1 exists, published, and visible in Learner App for Student A
Event setting Allow attendance response is enabled
Event setting Responders includes both Student and Parent
Student A and Parent A are linked correctly
Student A has not submitted a response for Event E1 yet
steps_actions:
1. Open Learner App as Student A and navigate to Event E1 detail
2. Tap attendance response action
3. Select status = Attend and tap Submit
4. Re-open Event E1 detail
steps_result:
1. Event detail screen is displayed with attendance response action available
2. Response form opens with lesson-like options
3. Submission succeeds and success feedback is shown
4. Submitted response is shown as Attend
steps_data:
1. Event E1
2. Student A
3. Status: Attend
4. Event E1
